product.title: Rome by E-bike: the guided tour of the city center

description.text: Go beyond your standard walking tour on this fun, sustainable adventure through Rome. Led by your personal guide, you'll hop on an e-bike to see both the Eternal City's most-famous attractions and a few hidden gems along the way. Stops include Historic center of Rome, Tiber River cycle path. You’ll zip from piazzas and squares to ancient ruins and beyond, discovering far more than you would on foot —and still traveling green. Ideal for visitors basing in Rome who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Historic center of Rome, Tiber River cycle path that define this Rome sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
